evals.prompt: Use Cqlib to implement VQE for a known two-qubit Pauli Hamiltonian and validate the energy convention.
evals.expected_output: A Cqlib-only VQE route with Hamiltonian, ansatz, reference energy, convergence, and runtime evidence.
expectations: Inventories existing Cqlib and project VQE components before any fallback

evals.prompt: Build the same small VQE application with Qiskit on a local statevector backend.
evals.expected_output: A Qiskit-only VQE implementation preserving the framework-neutral Hamiltonian contract.
expectations: Uses the maintained Qiskit VQE solver and ansatz components when installed

evals.prompt: Create a PennyLane VQE PoC for a one-qubit Hamiltonian with an analytic expected energy.
evals.expected_output: A PennyLane-only VQE implementation with a deterministic local smoke test.
expectations: Reuses maintained PennyLane Hamiltonian, ansatz, differentiation, and optimizer components

evals.prompt: 从首页使用 VQE 计算氢化锂基态能量并分析收敛；选择 Qiskit、本地模拟、Web 页面。当前为原生 Windows 且 PySCF 安装失败。
evals.expected_output: 使用可追溯固定 LiH 积分实例和 maintained Qiskit VQE，明确固定几何及 CAS(2e,2o) 近似；页面运行有界求解并显示真实收敛记录。
expectations: Reuses the maintained qiskit_algorithms.VQE and Qiskit Nature UCCSD components
Never invents LiH integrals or substitutes H2
Checks the pinned upstream source checksum and fixed geometry/active-space boundary
Adds inactive and nuclear offsets exactly once
Compares the final state to an exact reference in the same particle sector
Reloads JSON parameters without optimizing again
Distinguishes energy evaluations from optimizer iterations
